name: Mavis
says: Good heavens, love! Is that 'Real No.54' supposed to be a dish? It's thick enough to choke a bull while I tried to sip my tea in peace! And why did you go and build another kiosk just so Pea could stare at it while I'm trying to read my results?
wants: A proper lace doily to catch those rough bits of paper tearing into my table!
